_comment: Copy this file to machine_local.json (gitignored) on each machine and keep ONLY that machine's block as the actual content -- machine_local.json holds a single object, not both. Shown below are the two machines currently sharing branch 'alvaro', for reference.
_note: demo_login MUST be a member of sentinel_engine.live.guard_cuenta.SANCTIONED_DEMO_LOGINS -- machine_local.json can only SELECT a sanctioned login, never add a new one. If machine_local.json is absent entirely, Machine 1's values above are used as the default (see sentinel_engine/live/machine_profile.py). The AVA block above was verified empirically 2026-08-20: the running terminal64.exe process for D:\FOREX\MT5_Tester carries NO /portable flag on its command line (`wmic`/CIM inspection), hence portable=false; terminal_marker is the derived default (lower-cased parent dir name) and does not need to be set explicitly, shown here only for clarity.
